notes.title: Minor patch
notes.content: Dynamically set wall distance now includes world 5s, paddle travel distance is also dynamically set, and changed layer sorting order of ball.

notes.title: Paddleball is live!
notes.content: Added new paddleball game mode with an additional 25 levels, new power ups and power downs.  Also minor adjustments to world 2 levels and world 4 levels in pin ball.  Additionally a how to section has been added to the menu for each game mode.
